boss_intro: HA! A little blue visitor! Bruno was just about to flatten something — how lucky you came!
Welcome to the quarry, tiny rex! Everything here gets flattened eventually. Ha ha! Tradition!
The cog says CRUSH, so Bruno crushes! Nothing personal, small friend!
taunt_mid: Bruno is a LANDSLIDE! Landslides do not stop for lizards!
Still standing? Ha! I like you! CRUSH TIME anyway!
Forward! Forward is Bruno's favourite direction! Also his only one!
You dodge well, tiny one! Dodge THIS next!
Ha ha ha! This is the most fun Bruno has had all week!
hit_react: The little rex has BIG bonks!
low_hp: Bruno is… wobbling?! Landslides do not wobble!
The cog is rattling… my head feels… strange…
One more like that and Bruno takes an unscheduled nap!
defeat_freed: The cog is OFF! Bruno's head is Bruno's again! Ha… haha… THANK YOU, tiny rex!
Whoa. Bruno was being STEERED. Never again! You bonked me FREE!
Free! FREE! First stop: the café. Second stop: apologising to everyone Bruno flattened!
You fight with the brain AND the tail. Bruno respects both. FRIENDS NOW!
ask_intro: Rock quiz! Bruno LOVES rocks. Bruno was a quarry-master before the cog, you know!
Which rock is which, little rex? Show Bruno you were listening!
Bruno holds up a rock. YOU tell Bruno what it is!
Rocks are like friends: know their names! Ready?
correct_first_try: YES! You know your rocks! Bruno is SO PROUD!
Ha! Correct! You would make a fine quarry-master!
RIGHT! The rock approves. Bruno also approves!
correct_after_hint: There it is! Second swings count double in Bruno's book!
Correct! See — rocks make sense once you know their story!
That's the one! Ha ha! Knew you'd get there!
incorrect_gentle: Not that one — but no crushing worries! Want Bruno's hint?
Hmm, nope! Even Bruno once mixed up marble and granite. Hint?
Close! Rocks are tricky rascals. Bruno can give a clue!
hint_intro: Bruno whispers, which for Bruno is quite loud:
teach: Watch Bruno! Here is how the rock story goes, step by step.
No frowns! Bruno will show you — then YOU show Bruno!
cafe_farewell: Come back any time, tiny rex! Bruno saves you the comfy seat!
Ha ha! Best quiz of the day! Off you go — fossils wait for no rex!
